<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_733168_aes.AESCommunicationResolver</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>AESCommunicationResolver</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var AESCommunicationResolver = Class.create();
AESCommunicationResolver.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.COMMUNICATION_TABLE = 'x_733168_aes_communication';
        this.STATE_PUBLISHED = 'published';
        this.STATE_EXPIRED = 'expired';
    },

    /**
     * Returns communications eligible for a Display Type.
     *
     * The Display Type defines:
     * - the Communication table to query
     * - the eligibility condition applied to that table
     *
     * Global AES visibility rules are applied separately.
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord|string} displayType Display Type record or sys_id
     * @return {GlideRecord|null}
     */
    getCommunications: function(displayType) {
        var type = this._resolveDisplayType(displayType);

        if (!type)
            return null;

        if (type.getValue('active') != '1')
            return null;

        var tableName = type.getValue('communication_table');

        if (!this._isValidCommunicationTable(tableName))
            return null;

        var communication = new GlideRecord(tableName);

        /*
         * Global AES rule:
         * inactive communications are never displayable.
         */
        communication.addQuery('active', true);

        /*
         * Display Type-specific eligibility.
         */
        var condition = type.getValue('eligibility_condition');

        if (!gs.nil(condition))
            communication.addEncodedQuery(condition);

        /*
         * Publication date is a global visibility rule.
         *
         * A published communication cannot be displayed before
         * its configured publication date.
         *
         * Expired communications are intentionally not excluded here.
         */
        var dateQuery = communication.addNullQuery('publish_date');
        dateQuery.addOrCondition('publish_date', '<=', new GlideDateTime());

        communication.query();

        return communication;
    },

    /**
     * Determines whether one Communication is eligible for a Display Type.
     *
     * @param {GlideRecord|string} source Communication record or sys_id
     * @param {GlideRecord|string} displayType Display Type record or sys_id
     * @return {Boolean}
     */
    isVisible: function(source, displayType) {
        var type = this._resolveDisplayType(displayType);

        if (!type)
            return false;

        if (type.getValue('active') != '1')
            return false;

        var tableName = type.getValue('communication_table');

        if (!this._isValidCommunicationTable(tableName))
            return false;

        var communication = this._resolveCommunication(source, tableName);

        if (!communication)
            return false;

        if (!this._isActive(communication))
            return false;

        if (!this._isDateEligible(communication))
            return false;

        if (!this._matchesEligibilityCondition(communication, type))
            return false;

        return true;
    },

    /**
     * Evaluates the global temporal visibility rules.
     */
    _isDateEligible: function(communication) {
        var now = new GlideDateTime();
        var publishDate = communication.getValue('publish_date');
        var expirationDate = communication.getValue('expiration_date');
        var state = communication.getValue('state');

        /*
         * A future publication date is never visible.
         */
        if (!gs.nil(publishDate)) {
            var publish = new GlideDateTime(publishDate);

            if (publish.after(now))
                return false;
        }

        /*
         * Expired is a historical state.
         *
         * The Display Type decides whether Expired communications
         * are eligible through its eligibility condition.
         */
        if (state == this.STATE_EXPIRED)
            return true;

        /*
         * Current content must still be inside its publication window.
         */
        if (!gs.nil(expirationDate)) {
            var expiration = new GlideDateTime(expirationDate);

            if (!expiration.after(now))
                return false;
        }

        return true;
    },

    /**
     * Evaluates the Display Type eligibility condition against
     * the Communication table configured on the Display Type.
     */
    _matchesEligibilityCondition: function(communication, displayType) {
        var condition = displayType.getValue('eligibility_condition');

        if (gs.nil(condition))
            return true;

        var tableName = displayType.getValue('communication_table');

        var candidate = new GlideRecord(tableName);
        candidate.addQuery('sys_id', communication.getUniqueValue());
        candidate.addEncodedQuery(condition);
        candidate.setLimit(1);
        candidate.query();

        return candidate.hasNext();
    },

    /**
     * Resolves a Communication using the table configured
     * on the Display Type.
     *
     * This allows conditions to use fields defined by an
     * extended Communication table such as Announcement.
     */
    _resolveCommunication: function(source, tableName) {
        if (gs.nil(source))
            return null;

        var sysId = '';

        if (
            typeof source == 'object' &&
            typeof source.getUniqueValue == 'function'
        ) {
            if (!source.isValidRecord())
                return null;

            sysId = source.getUniqueValue();
        } else {
            sysId = source;
        }

        var communication = new GlideRecord(tableName);

        if (!communication.get(sysId))
            return null;

        return communication;
    },

    _resolveDisplayType: function(source) {
        if (gs.nil(source))
            return null;

        if (
            typeof source == 'object' &&
            typeof source.getTableName == 'function'
        ) {
            if (!source.isValidRecord())
                return null;

            return source;
        }

        var displayType =
            new GlideRecord('x_733168_aes_announcement_display_type');

        if (!displayType.get(source))
            return null;

        return displayType;
    },

    /**
     * Ensures that the configured table belongs to the
     * Communication hierarchy.
     */
    _isValidCommunicationTable: function(tableName) {
        if (gs.nil(tableName))
            return false;

        var hierarchy = new GlideTableHierarchy(this.COMMUNICATION_TABLE);
        var tables = hierarchy.getAllExtensions();

        for (var i = 0; i < tables.size(); i++) {
            if (tables.get(i) == tableName)
                return true;
        }

        return tableName == this.COMMUNICATION_TABLE;
    },

    _isActive: function(communication) {
        return communication.getValue('active') == '1';
    },

    type: 'AESCommunicationResolver'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-22 20:43:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>8677ff2093e30790ef30f2918bba10c7</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>AESCommunicationResolver</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Announcement Experience Suite" source="x_733168_aes">69255b1793db4b50ef30f2918bba10d5</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Announcement Experience Suite">69255b1793db4b50ef30f2918bba10d5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_8677ff2093e30790ef30f2918bba10c7</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-22 20:43:32</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
